title: CACO: Coverage-Aware Coordinated Optimization for Continuous Generative Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2611.25738v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continuous generative retrievers powered by flow matching and diffusion sample multiple queries in item embedding space for parallel approximate nearest-neighbor (ANN) search under fixed retrieval budgets. However, optimizing distribution diversity or target-level interest separation ignores set-level retrieval geometry: sampled queries collapse onto overlapping ANN neighborhoods, while discrete top-K lookup and single-target supervision block end-to-end coverage optimization. We introduce CACO (Coverage-Aware Coordinated Optimization), a lightweight self-supervised post-training framework that coordinates queries from frozen flow-matching and diffusion retrievers toward complementary item coverage with negligible additional inference latency. translated_title: CACO：面向连续生成式检索的覆盖感知协同优化
translated_abstract: 基于流匹配和扩散模型的连续生成式检索器在物品嵌入空间中采样多个查询，以在固定检索预算下进行并行的近似最近邻（ANN）搜索。然而，优化分布多样性或目标层面的兴趣分离忽略了集合层面的检索几何结构：采样出的查询坍缩到相互重叠的ANN邻域中，而离散的top-K查找和单目标监督又阻碍了端到端的覆盖优化。我们提出了CACO（覆盖感知协同优化），这是一个轻量级的自监督后训练框架，它将来自冻结的流匹配和扩散检索器的查询协调至互补的物品覆盖，且额外推理延迟几乎可以忽略。CACO利用跨采样参考查询的经验检索频率作为相关性代理，构建了一个无标签的覆盖目标，在所有30个骨干模型-数据集设置中都提升了召回率。
tldr: CACO是一种轻量级自监督后训练框架，通过覆盖感知的无标签目标将多个采样查询协调至互补的物品覆盖，在几乎不增加推理延迟的情况下显著提升连续生成式检索的召回率。
en_tdlr: CACO is a lightweight self-supervised post-training framework that coordinates sampled queries toward complementary item coverage via a label-free coverage-aware objective, substantially improving recall in continuous generative retrieval with negligible additional inference latency.
